text:
A circular, flat-bottomed dish contains 100cm3 of water.
Students are asked how to increase the rate at which the water evaporates.
Their suggestions are listed.
student 1
Pour the water into a flat-bottomed dish of larger diameter.
student 2
Cool the dish and water.
student 3
Create a current of air over the dish with a fan.
Which suggestions will increase the rate of evaporation?
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics
